description.fun: Heracross can hurl objects a hundred times its own weight with its horn, yet it's a gentle soul that mostly wants tree sap, sniffing it out with its antennae and sometimes dozing off mid-lick after a long search. Its horn ends in a cross on males and a heart on females. Based on the Japanese rhinoceros beetle, it's the counterpart of Pinsir: 'her' in Heracross, 'sir' in Pinsir.
description.guide: A Bug- and Fighting-type Pokémon based on the Japanese rhinoceros beetle, with a steel-hard shell and a long horn it uses to throw opponents. It loves tree sap. It does not evolve but can Mega Evolve into Mega Heracross.
description.tagline: A sap-loving beetle that can throw a hundred times its weight

description.fun: Mega Heracross runs so hot that it opens the shells on its arms and body to let the heat out, and in a flurry of attacks it can fire things like Pin Missile and Rock Blast straight from its forearms. It can lift 500 times its own weight, a fighter plane included, but its muscles ache once it changes back.
